title: Area registry index
description: Lists every area the `thaivia` CLI can operate on via `--area <id>` (G6-01, generalizing the single hardcoded th-bkk-pilot-001 area from G1-G5). Each entry's config_path points at a file validated against pilot-area.schema.json (the per-area schema; the filename predates this registry but the shape is already generic: id/bbox/CRS/driving_side/acquire_budget). Registering an area here is NOT a coverage or acquisition claim -- see that area's own config for coverage_status/coverage_status_reason.

config_path.description: Repo-root-relative path to this area's config JSON (validated against pilot-area.schema.json).
